summary: Ivanhoe Electric Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a $64.7 million equipment purchase agreement with Robbins for a tunnel boring machine to be used at its Santa Cruz Copper Project. The filing reports a binding option exercised and details milestone payments, delivery terms, liquidated damages of $50,000/day for delay, and a 10% liability cap. There is no change of control, acquisition, divestiture, or special situation event. This is a routine supply agreement for mining machinery, not a special-situations transaction. What to watch: project execution milestones and potential delays.
